enchantments.tooltip: Quality Charisma +1: This item makes the wearer have more flair, granting a +1 Quality bonus to Charisma.
Insightful Combat Mastery +3: +3 Insight bonus to the DC to resist the character's Trip, Improved Trip, Sunder, Improved Sunder, Stunning Blow, and Stunning Fist attempts.
Quality Deception +1: +1 Quality bonus to hit and +2 to damage for any hit that would qualify as a sneak attack.
Insightful Spell Focus Mastery +2: +2 Insight bonus to the DC of all spells.
